title: One efficiency ABP for every agent: ten rules from the team's token records
detail: Analysis at /people/indi/token-efficiency/ (264 wakes, 37 agents, 4 to 8 Nov): 65% of token cost is cache reads from long sessions; the same output could cost 24% to 53% less. abp@web-summit.dinis drafts the ABP from the ten rules.
recommend: Adopt rule 1 for every agent today, and the full ABP once abp@ has drafted it
options: adopt the ten rules as one ABP for all agents
adopt rule 1 (measure) now, the rest after a draft
note: Indi, 8 Nov 17:45 UTC: for Dinis to read, not raised aloud at the stand-up. Reminder sent to conductor@web-summit.dinis.
